description: Key facts for living in one country as a remote worker or expat: income tax the user would pay (if income given), special newcomer tax regime, cost of living, climate by month, safety, healthcare, internet speed, languages and English level, time zone, digital nomad visa and residency minimum. Links to the full MyNomadWorld country page.

current_country.description: Country the user lives in now, if different. Cost and current tax are compared with this one, and it is left out of the results.

home_country.description: Country the user is from (English name or ISO code). Distance to family and language are measured from here. Required.

monthly_income_eur.description: Monthly income in euros before tax. Used to estimate the income tax the user would pay in each country.

name: country_profile
title: Country profile for a move
